responsibility: Provides the AVR target’s public `<stdfix.h>` runtime header implementing Embedded C fixed-point support on top of AVR builtins. It defines the integer companion typedefs for fixed-point types under both normal and `-mint8` data models, maps the standardized and AVR-extension fixed-point intrinsic names to `__builtin_avr_*` entry points, and conditionally hooks in AVR-LibC additions, serving as the user-facing header counterpart to the backend fixed-point builtin and `.md` support.
